0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Toronto Raptors hosting the Chicago Bulls. Toronto will be without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, after surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot), while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and has Dailyn Swain (illness), Isaac Okoro (knee), Jordan Hawkins (illness), Leonard Miller (groin), Tobe Awaka (knee), and Zach Collins (toe, after surgery) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Raptors won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, and their most recent game against Chicago was a 139-109 Toronto win in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
